response.sql: WITH per_project AS (SELECT p.arcregistry AS project_id, p.fundflux AS funding_source, (1.0 * SUM(s.boxx)) / SUM(s.boxz) AS ratio FROM scanspatial s JOIN projects p ON p.arcregistry = s.arcref GROUP BY p.arcregistry, p.fundflux), with_avg AS (SELECT project_id, funding_source, ratio, AVG(ratio) OVER (PARTITION BY funding_source) AS avg_ratio FROM per_project) SELECT project_id, funding_source, ratio, ratio - avg_ratio AS excess FROM with_avg ORDER BY (ratio - avg_ratio) IS NULL, (ratio - avg_ratio) DESC, project_id LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: Projects whose boxz total is 0 or NULL (or whose boxx total is NULL) get a NULL ratio; SQLite returns NULL for division by zero. Such projects are left out of their funding source's average and sort last.
Projects with a NULL funding source are treated as one group for averaging.
Ties in excess are broken by project ID, which the request leaves unspecified.
